review.description: Reviewed maintain-flow-contracts S3/S4/S5 against main: two runner deadline fixtures accelerate their private cleanup observation while retaining original timer-value assertions; production runner cleanup is unchanged. Stable flow IDs, dependency ownership and pinned adoption remain unchanged.
review.implementation: The Go/UI startup fixtures preload an exact 5000 ms timer recorder and fire only that fixture timer at 100 ms. Existing unresponsive-build cancellation still exercises the real production cleanup timer. Child disappearance, private-state cleanup and supervisor ordering assertions remain active. Four fresh alternating runs on accepted main5097 each passed37/37 tests; baseline mean60.442s and candidate45.702s. Go correctness/performance startup assertions preserve60000/120000ms, UI preserves60000ms, and both assert original5000ms cleanup delay. The unresponsive-build cancellation case has no timer preload, sends SIGTERM twice3s apart and still checks exit143, child disappearance and private-directory cleanup within its existing bounds. Fresh full reconciliation and separate CI remain required.
